pr_title: Add tags list for repos whose release setting is disabled
pr_body: Close #23427 Co-Author: @wxiaoguang If a repo's release setting is enabled, the logic has't changed. Clicking the "Tags" button will jump to `/{user}/{repo}/tags` and `templates/repo/release/list.tmpl` template will be used. If the release setting is disabled, clicking the "Tags" button will still jump to `/{user}/{repo}/tags` but a new template `templates/repo/tag/list.tmpl` will be used. Since both templates above need to render the tags list, I moved the tags list to a shared template located in `templates/repo/tag/table.tmpl`.

issue_context.title: Disabled releases lead to 404 on tags page
issue_context.body:
### Description

Probably tags page should be still available, but when "releases" button is clicked is should say "Not available".


### Gitea Version

review_comments:
I do not think it looks good. And you lose the ability of `m.Post("/tags/delete", repo.DeleteTag, reqSignIn` and other handlers.
I didn't edit the `m.Post("/tags/delete"` handler, it's here:
https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/deafc1afffb399580d49e2af937a0e071d669c2d/routers/web/web.go#L1201-L1202

In this PR, I only add a tags list to show all tags when the release setting is disabled. And in this case, if users want to create or delete a tag, they can't do these things on the UI and they need to use `git` command to push the changes manually.
But users could delete a tag by Web UI

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2114189/233828655-8b45c720-5e5a-4b71-9d9b-170ea37951d9.png)
Maybe the question is that should we keep the delete button when users cannot create tags on the Web UI. IMO, users may find it strange if they can delete tags but cannot create tags, so I removed the delete button. If anyone thinks we don't need to remove this button, I could add it back.

In fact, I think the better solution is to separate the tag-related logic from the release-related logic so the tag-related functions won't be affected if the release setting is disabled. But it's a big work.
